story.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车队在X上表示，Q2最初几圈完成后乔治暂时领先，赛道状况正在提升，预计圈速会更快。

story.originalTitle: First few laps on the board in Q2 and George is currently setting the pace 👊 The track looks to be ramping up so expect the lap times to start gett...
story.summaryEn:
First few laps on the board in Q2 and George is currently setting the pace 👊
The track looks to be ramping up so expect the lap times to start getting quicker.
detailZh:
Q2的最初几圈已经完成，乔治目前暂列最快 👊
赛道状况看起来正在提升，所以预计圈速会开始变快。

First few laps on the board in Q2 and George is currently setting the pace 👊
The track looks to be ramping up so expect the lap times to start getting quicker.
